slides.hook: the only 4 back exercises i do

slides.name: Pulldown
slides.text: wide or neutral grip. drive your elbows down to your sides, don't lean way back.

slides.name: Cable Pullover
slides.text: arms long. sweep the bar down to your thighs. feel the stretch at the top.

slides.name: Chest-Supported Row
slides.text: chest stays on the pad so you can't swing. pull your elbows back.

slides.name: Shrug
slides.text: straight up, pause at the top. no rolling your shoulders.

slides.title: where they go in my week

slides.label: real tip (don't skip this)
slides.text: track every working set. if you don't know what you lifted last time, you can't beat it.
